text.p: Burlington Air Express said it won a $3.5 million contract today with Epson America to be its primary carrier for world wide air and ocean freight.

Under the terms of the contract, BAX will handle all of Epson's international and domestic air freight business for printers, including finished and partly assembled products, the company said in a statement.
The carrier said all domestic air freight will be moved via an overnight service, while outside the U.S., the contract calls for 48 hour door-to-door service.
The bulk of Epson's non-U.S. business is for goods made in Asia and shipped to end-users. Epson is an affiliate of Seiko Corp - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
